summary: Security fix: fail closed when Linux local caller ancestry has an empty or incomplete environment.

compatibility.detail: Linux callers with empty or non-NUL-terminated environ are unverifiable rather than persons. Existing unverifiable-caller guards refuse authority-bearing requests; ordinary unattributed reads remain available. A deliberately empty environment also fails closed. Fork-only children with complete environments and macOS callers are unchanged.

recovery.detail: Invoke authority-bearing local requests from a process with a readable, nonempty, complete environment.
